endcard: Save this for the moment anger rises

save.ar:
لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ
إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
save.tr: “The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.”

lines.say: Ever said something in anger that you could never take back?
The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength,
lines.cap: “The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength…”

lines.say: but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger.
lines.cap: “…but the one who controls himself while in anger.”

lines.say: A man said to him: Advise me! He said: Do not become angry. The man asked again and again, and each time the answer was the same: Do not become angry.
And Allah praises those who restrain anger and who pardon the people. And Allah loves the doers of good.
lines.cap: “…who restrain anger and who pardon the people”

lines.say: Ibn Kathir explains: they do not act on their anger, and they forgive those who wronged them.
lines.cap: They don't act on their anger. They forgive.

lines.say: Next time anger rises, hold it. That is real strength.
Save this, and send it to someone who needs it today.
lines.cap: Save this & send it to someone who needs it today 🤍

v1.ar:
وَٱلْكَـٰظِمِينَ ٱلْغَيْظَ وَٱلْعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ
وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
v1.tr: “…and who restrain anger and who pardon the people – and Allāh loves the doers of good.”
